headline: Historic maximum. Cargo transportation via "Irkeshtam" exceeded 4 million tons
summary: Freight volume through the Chinese side of the Irkeshtam crossing on the Kyrgyzstan border exceeded 4 million tonnes for the first time since the start of 2026. It is a record for the crossing.
why: Irkeshtam is a land route linking China and Kyrgyzstan, so its freight volumes reflect trade flows between Central Asia and China. Rising cargo through border crossings is a signal of regional trade activity.
original_headline: Исторический максимум. Грузоперевозки через «Иркештам» превысили 4 миллиона тонн
